projects.title: TatNav — booking marketplace for tattoo artists
projects.description: A two-sided marketplace connecting people with tattoo artists — browse portfolios, check availability, and book appointments, while artists manage their profile, services, and bookings from an owner portal. Built end-to-end: a Next.js web app, a React Native mobile app for iOS and Android, and a NestJS API, with Stripe payments and Keycloak authentication, deployed on a self-managed Kubernetes cluster.

projects.title: TeamTel — Microsoft Teams voice system builder
projects.description: Built with my co-founder to simplify creating Microsoft Teams voice systems, with a visual call-flow builder. Paused while other projects take priority, but still on the roadmap to finish.

projects.title: BookGusto — restaurant landing page
projects.description: Built the marketing landing page for BookGusto. The wider restaurant management system it was meant to plug into didn't move past that stage.

projects.title: FretVault — guitar practice companion
projects.description: A university project: a mobile app for guitarists to log gear, tabs, and practice notes. Was meant to open-source it, but never got it fully polished.

expCards.review: TatNav went from an idea to a live, full-stack marketplace spanning web, mobile, and infrastructure — a genuinely complete product.
expCards.title: Founder & Full Stack Developer
responsibilities: Built TatNav end-to-end: a Next.js web app, a NestJS API, and a React Native mobile app for iOS and Android.
Set up Keycloak authentication, Stripe payments, and Cloudflare R2 storage.
Deployed and run the platform on a self-managed Kubernetes cluster with GitOps CI/CD.

expCards.review: Sebastian brought creativity and technical expertise to the team, significantly improving our frontend performance. His work has been invaluable in delivering faster experiences.
expCards.title: Frontend Developer
responsibilities: Built the marketing landing page for the BookGusto website.
Collaborated closely with UI/UX designers to ensure seamless user experiences.
The wider restaurant management system it was meant to plug into didn't move past that stage.

expCards.review: Sebastian's work on TeamTel's call flow builder showed real problem-solving ability, even with the project on hold.
expCards.title: Co-founder & Full Stack Developer
responsibilities: Co-founded TeamTel, a platform for building Microsoft Teams voice systems.

expCards.review: FretVault was a strong university project — a solid mobile app that showed real product thinking, even if it never made it to open source.
